title: Daily invite limit for Free orgs
input: uncommitted changes on main at abc1234

terms.means: an email that asks someone to join the org

willNotProve: the reset at 00:00 UTC, parallel sends

claims.statement: Where the org is on Free, the app sends at most 10 invites a day.
claims.given: Owner of a new Free org signed up today. 9 invites sent today.

cases.expect: "Daily invite limit reached. Try again tomorrow." (new)

cases.do: On a Pro org with 10 sent today, send one more

claims.evidence: GIF of each send; text on screen after each send
claims.risk: Owners locked out or spam allowed

claims.statement: If an invite is refused, then it does not count toward the daily limit of 10 invites.
claims.given: Owner of a new Free org signed up today. 9 invites sent today.

cases.do: Send an invite to an already invited address, then a new address
cases.expect: First: "This person is already invited."; second: Toast "Invite sent"

claims.evidence: GIF of each send; text on screen after each send
claims.risk: Owners locked out or spam allowed

claims.statement: Where the org is on a paid plan, the app sends more than 10 invites a day.
claims.given: Owner of a new Pro org signed up today. 10 invites sent today.
claims.evidence: GIF of each send; text on screen after each send
claims.risk: Owners locked out or spam allowed

claims.statement: When a Free org is at its daily limit, the app shows "Daily invite limit reached. Try again tomorrow." (new).
claims.given: Owner of a new Free org signed up today. 10 invites sent today.

cases.expect: "Daily invite limit reached. Try again tomorrow." (new)

claims.evidence: GIF of each send; text on screen after each send
claims.risk: Owners locked out or spam allowed
